CMFT.description: Equivalent Moment Correction Factor Cm (CMFT). When OPT_AUTO is false, the manual correction factors CMY and CMZ (each in the range 0.0 to 1.0) are applied.

OPT_AUTO.description: boolean Auto Calculate. When true, the equivalent moment correction factor is auto-calculated and CMY/CMZ are ignored; when false, CMY and CMZ are used.

CMY.description: CMy, equivalent moment correction factor about the y-axis. Applied when OPT_AUTO is false. Must satisfy 0.0 <= value <= 1.0.

CMZ.description: CMz, equivalent moment correction factor about the z-axis. Applied when OPT_AUTO is false. Must satisfy 0.0 <= value <= 1.0.
